title: When a UI-pass diff touches only `_test.go` files under internal/tui, tell the ui role in the brief that no renders are expected

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
When the UI pass has a slice whose Files section names a UI path, ork starts the `ui` role. If the diff changes only test files, no view changed and the role has nothing to render, but its brief still carries the renders requirements. In ork run ork-20261125-185405-f675 (item S531) the diff was only `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go`, and the role had to rule the render requirement out by hand. The requirements it had to rule out were the "Renders" section of `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md` and the Done-when item "Produce the required renders or explain each blocked view; list the files produced" (`internal/engine/brief.go:452`).

ork already reads the changed paths for the reviewer (`branchPaths`, `internal/engine/brief.go:576`). It can use them when it builds the UI round. When every changed path is a `_test.go` file under `internal/tui`, the UI round's brief gets a section "No renders expected" that says so. The Done-when item for renders is replaced by one that says the same. A round whose diff touches any other path, or whose diff cannot be read, is built as it is today.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:606-624` (`review` adds the section to the UI round; new helper `onlyTUITestFiles` beside `sliceTouchesUI` at `:826`)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:451-454` (`doneWhen`, the `RoleUI` case, plus a new title constant `uiNoRendersTitle`)
- `internal/engine/uipass_test.go` (new tests; the file exists)
- `docs/design.md:787-853` (the UI pass bullet states the new rule)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All in `internal/engine/uipass_test.go`.
- TestOnlyTUITestFiles: a table for `onlyTUITestFiles(paths []string) bool`. It is true for one `internal/tui/x_test.go`, for two such files, and for `internal/tui/sub/x_test.go`. It is false for an empty list, for `internal/tui/model.go`, for `internal/tui/testdata/golden/x.txt`, for `internal/engine/x_test.go`, for `internal/cli/x_test.go`, for `internal/tui2/x_test.go`, and for a list that mixes `internal/tui/x_test.go` with `internal/tui/model.go`.
- TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyTUITestsChanged: the slice's Files names `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go`, and the routed diff is `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go` only. The UI pass's brief holds `## No renders expected` and a Done-when item that says no renders are expected and none are to be written. It holds no Done-when item starting "Produce the required renders". The reviewer's brief holds neither.
- TestUIPassBriefKeepsRendersWhenAViewChanged: the routed diff is `internal/tui/x_test.go` and `internal/tui/model.go`. The UI pass's brief has no `No renders expected` section and still has the "Produce the required renders" Done-when item.
- TestUIPassBriefHasNoRendersNoteWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead: the routed `git diff` exits 1. The UI pass still runs once, its brief has no `No renders expected` section, and the run reaches awaiting approval.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the four tests first (names under Failing tests) and see them fail. Build each harness with `newHarness` and a `routesFor` that returns the slicer show route from `uiSliceJSON` plus the git routes that `internal/engine/decisionpaths_test.go:58-60` uses (`merge-base main HEAD`, `diff --name-only -z --no-renames --no-relative base`, and `ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z --full-name`). Set `h.cfg.Lineup[RoleUI]` as `uiHarness` does.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, add `const uiNoRendersTitle = "No renders expected"`.
3. In `internal/engine/states.go`, add `onlyTUITestFiles(paths []string) bool`. It is true only when `paths` is not empty and every path starts with `internal/tui/` and ends with `_test.go`.
4. In `review` (`internal/engine/states.go:620-623`), when `ui` is true, call `e.branchPaths(ctx, rec)`. If it returns no error and `onlyTUITestFiles(paths)` is true, append a `BriefSection{Title: uiNoRendersTitle, Body: ...}` to the UI round's sections. On a `branchPaths` error, add no section and do not pause: the round is built as today. The body says:
   - the diff changes only `_test.go` files under `internal/tui`, so no view, golden file or doc changed;
   - no renders are expected, so write no files in the renders directory;
   - say so in the report, naming the changed files, and write "nothing" for each empty section.
5. In `doneWhen`, in the `RoleUI` case (`internal/engine/brief.go:452`), check `in.Sections` for a section titled `uiNoRendersTitle`, as the `Finish step` case does at `:376`. When it is there, replace the "Produce the required renders or explain each blocked view; list the files produced." text with: "No renders are expected: the diff changes only test files under internal/tui. Write no render files and say so in your report." Keep the rest of the item, from "Complete sections (A)-(D)" on.
6. In `docs/design.md`, in the UI pass bullet after the Renders paragraph (around `:839`), add that when the diff's paths are all `_test.go` files under `internal/tui`, the UI round's brief gets a "No renders expected" section and a matching Done-when item, and that a diff that cannot be read adds neither.
7. Run `go -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork test ./internal/engine`, then the checks under Check. Do not change `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`, the goldens or the approval card.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A UI round whose diff is only _test.go files under internal/tui has a brief with a "No renders expected" section and a Done-when item that says no renders are expected.
- A diff with any other path, or no readable diff, gives a brief with no such section and the unchanged renders Done-when item.
- The reviewer's brief never gets the section.

Commands:
- `go test -run TestOnlyTUITestFiles ./internal/engine` exits 0 and all its subtests pass.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyTUITestsChanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefKeepsRendersWhenAViewChanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefHasNoRendersNoteWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l ./engine` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- [HUMAN CHECK] On the next slice whose diff is only _test.go files under internal/tui, open the ui role's brief in the run directory. It should hold ## No renders expected and no "Produce the required renders" Done-when item. The ui report should say that no renders were expected.
